messages:
claire: Quick emergency: Marshmallow (my golden retriever) just discovered how to do the moonwalk. video incoming 4363a4
photo-bot: claire uploaded 1 file
ash: moonwalk?? prove it or it didn't happen 914
claire: attaching video—he glides backward three steps then barks like he closed a deal 602
todd: this is a content strategy. we need a GIF, a sticker, and a morale slide. also a tiny cape.
kyle: vote for tiny cape. also can we trademark the pose as the "PupWalk"? i'm already drafting merch ideas 3f8
ash: marketing aside, is he okay? any treats involved in the training? 
claire: fully healthy. bribery involved: half a puppuccino and a squeaky toy. he moonwalks for both.
todd: technical question: is the moonwalk repeatable on carpet, hardwood, or only on my soul?
claire: hardwood and tile confirmed. carpet = dramatic slide + zero moonwalks. we lose traction.
kyle: suggestion: schedule a weekly "Marshmallow Minute" for standups. 60 seconds of canine cheer. objections?
nash: no objections. 60 seconds is scientifically proven to increase mood by 12% (citation: my heart) 
claire: made a calendar invite for Friday 10:00. title: "Marshmallow Moonwalk & Puppuccino"
todd: i will craft intro music. maybe a brass riff and tiny drumroll.
kyle: if we monetize this i call dibs on naming rights for the cape color.
claire: update: Marshmallow also requests that no one wear loafers around him—he thinks they're chew toys. end thread.
